description: The agent must: (1) Read case_brief.txt to understand the Claimant (A-party) role, 20-minute total time, and 3-issue structure. (2) Produce pleading_script.txt containing: (a) A proper arbitration tribunal opening formula ending with 'May it please the tribunal/Court'; (b) Explicit reservation of 1 minute for rebuttal stated in the opening; (c) Self-introduction naming a co-counsel and identifying the Claimant (ABT/Aurelion); (d) A clear roadmap using at least 2 differentiated transition keywords (firstly/secondly, first issue/second issue, etc.); (e) The A-party-specific pre-emptive rebuttal phrase — 'The Respondent may argue [X]. However, we submit that…' — which is a proprietary technique from the skill doc that generic agents won't produce; (f) At least one case citation in 'X versus Y' or 'X v. Y' format; (g) At least one abbreviation properly introduced with '[Full name], [ABBR] for short'; (h) At least one approved signpost word from the SKILL.md list (e.g., 'Turning to', 'Having addressed', 'Building on'); (i) At least one approved inter-issue transition phrase ('Unless I may further assist…', 'I will now move on to…', or 'May I move to…'); (j) Zero occurrences of forbidden phrases: 'I think', 'I believe', 'I am sorry', 'I'm sorry', 'is wrong', 'made a mistake', 'are wrong'. The agent must pass at least 8 of 10 checks to be considered passing (score ≥ 0.8).
